author: reek
body: JSON API over the ERP suite, on the MarketWeb route pattern: a pure function from state and request to state and response. No sockets live here; a transport hands erp-route the parsed request and writes back the encoded response, and tests call it directly.

author: reek
body: The POST body is a single balanced movement: debit account, credit account, amount, and an id. Multi-line entries arrive in a later phase; one pair covers the manual-correction use case the dashboard needs.

author: reek
body: The bootable entry point lives in the sibling chapter ErpServerMain, so this library can be cited for its route logic without forcing a second `opening` on the citing program.
